q: If my plant captures CO2, can I subtract it from Scope 1?
title: Captured CO2 in your inventory
short: Report gross Scope 1 first. Show CO2 captured and permanently stored, or sold on, as a separate line with its destination. CO2 sold for drinks or chemicals is released later, so it is not a removal. Never net it out silently; buyers and verifiers will ask.
audience: Plants with CO2 recovery or capture units

ul: Tonnes captured, and where they went: storage, sale or use.
Energy used by the capture unit, in Scope 1 or 2.
Calling CO2 sold to a bottler a removal.
Leaving out the capture unit's own fuel and power.

senseible: Senseible keeps each bill and invoice behind every figure, dated and fingerprinted, so a reviewer can trace a number back to the document it came from.
